rank_math_title: How to File for Divorce in Florida (2027): 20 Days, ~$400
rank_math_description: Florida divorce 2027: 6-month residency, 20-day wait, about $400 to file ($408 Collier), simplified dissolution, disclosure and alimony after 2023.
focus_keyword: how to file for divorce in florida
pdf_outline: Checklist: residency proof (DL/ID/voter card or Form 12.902(i)) -> simplified vs regular -> petition + financial affidavit -> file (~$400) or indigent application -> service/answer (20 days) -> mandatory disclosure within 45 days + 12.932 -> MSA / parenting plan / worksheet -> parenting course -> 20-day minimum -> final hearing

editor_notes: Fee: Collier County Clerk ($408 petition, $10 summons). Statutory base up to $295 under §28.241(1)(a)1.b for ch. 61 cases plus surcharges; if you prefer Miami-Dade/Broward/Hillsborough figures, confirm on the clerk site. Florida Supreme Court form PDFs were not fetched from the cloud; form numbers follow the approved family law forms list, so spot-check before publishing.
